lines: "Rats take it this year. Written down, witnessed, done."
"The Rustpile Rats have not finished a season upright since the towers went dark."
"Due is a word losers invented so they'd keep buying tickets. A bad club is bad for reasons, and the reasons don't expire in the winter."
"Kingfishers then. You're a Kingfishers man now?"
"I'm a nobody-wins man. Cheaper, and I'm right more often."
